notes: Domestic rights are split 50/50 per matchday between ESPN Premium (Disney, deal to 2030 with a possible one-year extension) and TNT Sports Premium (Warner Bros. Discovery, extended to 2031); both are sold together in the pay-TV 'Pack Futbol' (Flow, DirecTV, Telecentro, etc.). No free-to-air coverage of league matches was found for 2026. International rights holders for 2026 are poorly documented: the only 2026 source names Fanatiz as the AFA-endorsed platform for viewers abroad. The Wikipedia league article lists older/undated international holders (ESPN and TyC Sports International in Latin America, Paramount+ in the US 'since 2021', beIN Sports in France, Dubai Sports in MENA); these could not be confirmed for 2026 and were left out. The 442 (Perfil) article is a news piece about legal viewing options; its URL slug references piracy only because it contrasts legal options with it.

broadcasters.note: ESPN Premium and TNT Sports Premium each show half of every matchday; full coverage requires the joint premium 'Pack Futbol' via pay-TV operators. ESPN also airs two games per matchday on its basic pay-TV channels (per TAVI, April 2025). TNT Sports can be bought without a cable plan via Max (DPL News, April 2025). Disney+ gives access to ESPN's football in certain plans when linked to the pack (442, Feb 2026). No free-to-air league coverage found.
Described in Feb 2026 as the digital platform endorsed by the AFA for following the tournament from abroad. Exact territories and any exclusions per country not confirmed.
